name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Sync bank transactions from SimpleFin into Wealthfolio automatically.
author: Bubbles840

permissions.purpose: Show existing accounts, and optionally create new Wealthfolio accounts, for mapping to SimpleFin accounts

Import bank transactions, reconcile pending transactions (create/update/delete), and link transfer pairs. On Wealthfolio 3.9 and newer: link and unlink transfers in place, and read whether a transaction is linked and what it is filed under

Read your spending categories' names, to show what a transaction is filed under. On Wealthfolio 3.9 and newer: file a deposit you mark as a payback under the spending it pays back, through a one-off filing rule the add-on makes, runs and deletes
Open a mapped account's page in Wealthfolio when its row is clicked
Read current account balances to size one-time starting-balance corrections, and read which holdings an investment account has priced, so only a holding with no price is looked at
Store SimpleFin credentials and sync configuration securely
Fetch transaction data from SimpleFin Bridge
Register sidebar navigation item and route for SimpleFin Sync
Import holdings snapshots for investment accounts, so a brokerage syncs its positions and not only its cash.
Read whether a holding is priced by the market or by hand, and switch one Wealthfolio has no price for (a basket of stocks reported as one holding) to manual pricing
List your loans, so a SimpleFin loan account can be linked to the one it records its balance on

Check whether a holding has any market price, and write the day's price for one that has none, from the value your bank reports. Record a linked loan account's balance on your Wealthfolio loan, as that day's confirmed balance
